canonical_statement: For every elliptic curve E over Q, E(Q)_tors is isomorphic either to Z/nZ for 1 <= n <= 10 or n = 12, or to Z/2Z x Z/2mZ for 1 <= m <= 4.
domains: E an elliptic curve over Q
hypotheses: E is nonsingular and defined over Q
conclusion: The abstract additive group of rational torsion points has one of the fifteen listed group types.
excluded_claims: curves over number fields other than Q

alternate_encodings.target: ZMod 2 x ZMod n with n in {2,4,6,8}
